data.body: Patchset 3 (change 2193): fixed CI regression. Root cause: plan_pass assumed every ctx.mutations item is a typed Mutation, but the reconcile path legitimately mixes typed Mutations with legacy plain-dict mutations (documented dual shape in run_differs). Fix: filter ctx.mutations to typed items (duck-typed on .target) at the run_differs shadow-attach seam before plan_pass; legacy dicts are not part of the typed planning surface. Added held-out regression test test_run_differs_shadow_plan_tolerates_legacy_dict_mutations (teeth-verified: reverting the filter -> AttributeError at ticket_planner.py:112). Full reconciler suite 3362 passed, lint+typecheck clean.
